messages.subject: RHIPE installation failed

messages.author: c604b89d9c6ef07d
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: RHIPE installation failed
parts:
You can follow this post to build R as shared library:

http://groups.google.com/group/brumail/browse_thread/thread/39e32c7df63bc5c1?hl=en_US 

I think in the above post, it is for building R as static library:


In order to build R as shared library:

Export CFLAGS=-fPIC
Export CXXFLAGS=-fPIC
./configure –with-x=no –enable-R-shlib=”yes”
make
# copy the libR.so from $R_HOME/lib to /usr/local/lib64/R/lib

Regards,
Som
